name: Bully Hill Vineyards
address: 8843 Greyton H. Taylor Memorial Drive, Hammondsport, NY 14840
hoursNote: Wine shop/tasting room daily 10:00–17:00. Restaurant serves lunch: Mon–Thu 11:30–15:00, Fri–Sat 11:30–16:00, Sun 11:00–15:00. Includes FLX Wine Museum and Walter S. Taylor Art Gallery. Verify hours seasonally.
description: Fun, family-friendly winery on Keuka Lake's south end offering tastings of 40+ wines with lake views, casual lunch dining, and the FLX Wine Museum with the Walter S. Taylor Art Gallery on site.

name: Keuka Lake Vineyards
hoursNote: Seasonal hours; typically open daily 11:00–17:00 with extended Friday evening hours. Call ahead to confirm current schedule.
description: Small estate winery on Keuka Lake's south shore specializing in premium dry wines, produced with a focus on sustainable viticulture in the Finger Lakes tradition.

name: Keuka Spring Vineyards
hoursNote: Open daily 11:00–17:00. Outdoor Pavilion open Friday and Saturday evenings 18:00–21:00 in season, weather dependent. Hours may vary in the off-season.
description: Family-owned estate winery on Keuka Lake's east shore offering daily tastings, a wine club, and a seasonal outdoor concert pavilion open on summer evenings.

name: Domaine LeSeurre Winery
hoursNote: Walk-in tastings welcome daily; no reservation required for standard tasting. Reservations recommended for Signature Wine & Gourmet French Macaron or Wine & Food pairing experiences. Verify hours seasonally.
description: French-inspired Keuka Lake winery with walk-in tastings, gourmet cheese and charcuterie boards, and wine-and-macaron pairing experiences reflecting a Burgundian winemaking heritage.

name: Weis Vineyards
hoursNote: No reservations accepted; maximum group size 8 per tasting. Last tasting begins at 4:45 PM. Tasting spaces include a restored 1800s Schoolhouse (weekends in main season), a rustic Barn, and outdoor Tables.
description: Multiple-time New York State Winery of the Year, offering tastings in a restored 1800s schoolhouse and a rustic barn with sweeping views of Keuka Lake and its estate vineyards.

name: Vineyard View Winery
address: 2971 Williams Hill Road, Keuka Park, NY 14478
hoursNote: Peak season (Memorial Day–October) open daily 10:00–17:00. Off-season (November–May) open Thursday–Monday 12:00–17:00. Closed Easter, Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, and New Year's Day. On-site Vineyard House available for overnight stays.
description: Certified-sustainable family winery on Keuka Lake's east bluff producing award-winning estate wines, with sweeping lake views and an on-site Vineyard House guesthouse.

name: Stever Hill Vineyards
hoursNote: June–December open daily 10:00–17:00. January–May open Thursday–Monday only; closed Tuesday–Wednesday. Offers wine, craft beer, and cider tastings in a barn setting.
description: Branchport winery on Keuka Lake's west branch with a cozy barn tasting room, offering estate wine, craft beer, and cider against a backdrop of vineyard and lake views.

name: McGregor Vineyard
hoursNote: Open daily 11:00–17:00; walk-ins seated until 4:15 PM. Reservations recommended for the best visiting experience.
description: Estate winery on Keuka Lake's east bluff producing handpicked quality dry wines from organically managed vineyards, with decades of Finger Lakes winemaking heritage.

name: Barrington Cellars / Buzzard Crest Vineyards
hoursNote: Open Memorial Day through Veterans Day, Friday–Saturday 11:00–17:00 only. Also open select holiday Sundays (Memorial Day, July 4th, and Labor Day weekends). Closed the remainder of the year except by appointment for wine sales.
description: Small family farm winery on a hilltop above Keuka Lake, producing organic estate wines with deck seating offering vineyard and clear-water lake views.

name: Rooster Hill Vineyards
hoursNote: Open daily 11:00–18:00. No reservation required for groups of 7 or fewer; larger groups should call or email ahead.
description: Boutique estate winery on Keuka Lake's east shore near Penn Yan, offering relaxed Finger Lakes wine tastings in a welcoming, unpretentious tasting room.

name: Ravines Wine Cellars
hoursNote: Keuka Lake tasting room hours vary by season; verify current days and times at ravineswine.com or call before visiting. Reservations recommended.
description: Keuka Lake tasting room of the award-winning Ravines Wine Cellars, known for classically styled Finger Lakes wines including critically acclaimed dry Riesling and Pinot Noir.

name: Deep Root Vineyard
hoursNote: Closed Tuesday–Wednesday. Official website may be inactive; call (315) 651-2201 to confirm current hours and status before visiting.
description: Women-owned boutique winery on the west side of Keuka Lake near Hammondsport, producing small-batch, limited-edition wines in a personal and relaxed tasting environment.

name: Keuka Overlook Wine Cellars
hoursNote: Seasonal weekend-only hours; call (607) 292-6877 to verify current schedule before visiting. On-site Keuka Overlook B&B Inn also available.
description: Premium hilltop winery and bed-and-breakfast perched on a ridge with panoramic views of both Keuka Lake and Waneta Lake, producing award-winning New York State wines.

name: Yates Cellars
hoursNote: June–October open daily 12:00–18:00. May and November open Friday–Sunday only. Check website for winter hours or closure periods.
description: Boutique family winery in a historic 19th-century mansion in Keuka Park, offering estate-grown varietal wines with scenic views of Keuka Lake.
